about_the_game:
In a world where information is valued above all else, your mission is to obtain data capable of changing the course of scientific progress and shaping the future. Using the unique ability to remotely control a miniature cockroach, you will gain access to restricted areas, bypass security systems, and face unexpected obstacles.

Key Features:

  • Unique Gameplay: control the cockroach and feel not like a superhero, but like a tiny, vulnerable insect.

  • Stealth and Strategy: your diminutive size grants advantages and imposes limitations — use it wisely.

  • Engaging Storyline: immerse yourself in the narrative — there will be no easy choices.

  • Puzzles and Secrets: some puzzles will be, to say the least, very challenging; you’ll need to deploy all your resources to solve them.

  • Assistant: with our intelligent assistant, you will never be alone, even if you desperately want to be.

Are you ready to embark on a mission where your eyes, ears, and little legs belong to a tiny spy?

short_description: A spy mission awaits you with an unusual agent-a cockroach! You’ll have to infiltrate a scientist’s house,solve puzzles,search for codes,and see the world from a completely new perspective. The puzzles will be challenging,and you’ll always have your helpful(or not-so-helpful) assistant by your side.
